verdict.rationale: SerpApi has a public pricing page with search-based plans, including a Free $0/month tier with 250 searches. It also offers self-serve plan controls like Automatic Early Renewal, and clearly states that cached searches are free and don't count toward monthly searches, so a developer can see the per-search model without contacting sales. Missing for 10: explicit dollar prices for paid tiers (e.g., Production Plan) in the evidence, per-search overage cost details, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.
